body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Astak(www.astak.com) presented its 6-inch eBook reader device 'EZ Reader' at the CES 2009.

The EZ Reader offers a library of 2,000 books gently in user hand while listening to full stereo music holding thousands of songs. This EZ READER uses no electricity at all to display a page of text (in many font sizes). It weighs 6.5 ounces and is only 3-inch thick. And it has a 6-inch E-Ink screen and new IP cameras and the sharpest.
